"""Split by target root, at module level; the names keep their order and aliases."""

from pathlib import Path

from threetears.evals.host import EvalServiceError, ValidationFailedError
from threetears.evals.shapes import JUDGE_KIND as judge_kind
from threetears.evals.ops import (
    LaunchArguments,
    OpsHost,
    runs_list,
)
from threetears.evals.schema import DEFAULT_JOB_LEASE_S  # noqa: E402
from threetears.evals.host import EvalHost, HostProfile
from threetears.evals.analysis import service as analysis_service
from threetears.evals import Eval


def build(root: Path) -> OpsHost:
    return OpsHost(root, EvalHost(), HostProfile(), Eval, analysis_service)


__all__ = ["DEFAULT_JOB_LEASE_S", "EvalServiceError", "LaunchArguments", "ValidationFailedError", "judge_kind", "runs_list"]
